entries.en: You fuckin' killed 'em!

entries.en: What'd you think we'd do? Bind their hands with duct tape, shove socks in their mouths, and wait for 'em to wriggle free and call for help?
entries.ro: Ce credeai că o să facem? Să le legăm mâinile cu bandă adezivă, să le bagăm șosete-n gură și să așteptăm să se zbată până scapă și să ceară ajutor?

entries.en: This ain't no game, V. It's a simple choice – them or us. I chose us.
entries.ro: Nu e de joacă, V. E simplu – ei sau noi. Eu am ales noi.

entries.en: They didn't know anything.
entries.ro: Nu știau nimic.

entries.en: Right... Greater good, need to make tough calls.
entries.ro: Sigur... Pentru binele general, trebuie să iei decizii grele.

entries.en: It's a game, your fuckin' spy game they weren't playin'. They were innocent.
entries.ro: E un joc, jocul tău nenorocit de-a spionii, la care ei nici nu jucau. Erau nevinovați.

entries.en: You're right.
entries.ro: Ai dreptate.

entries.en: That's not quite how I'd describe two pro criminals.
entries.ro: N-aș zice chiar așa despre doi infractori de meserie.

entries.en: The greater good, the lesser evil – in the end it's the same, whatever comforts you and helps you do the right thing.
entries.ro: Binele general, răul cel mai mic – la urma urmei e totuna, orice te liniștește și te ajută să faci ce trebuie.

entries.en: Swap out your outfit, and let's roll with this.

entries.en: [Get in] I'll drive.
entries.ro: [Intră] Eu conduc.

entries.en: Takin' the wheel.

entries.en: Plan was to kill 'em all along. You knew, Alex.

entries.en: Wanna be all practical, they brought it on themselves.

entries.en: A'right, we have fresh disguises all ready. But you still need to lift the access codes off 'em. Aurore's the one to check for those.
entries.ro: Bine, avem deghizările gata. Dar tot trebuie să le iei codurile de acces de la ei. Aurore e cea care le verifică.

entries.en: This feels wrong.

entries.en: Ugh… This feels so fucked up…

entries.en: Expect me to believe you've never taken anything off a body before?

entries.en: Definitely. Her brother transfers his memories to external databanks, and he's had these stolen before. They wouldn't risk losing these codes.
